scientific.integrity: The motivating open full text was inspected at the Markov-chain probability definitions, the virulence-transmission tradeoff, the reproduction-number optimization, and Figures 3-5. The supporting HIV virulence paper was inspected at its model and intermediate-virulence conclusion. The bundled symbolic checker reconstructs the constrained optimization exactly. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The finding corrects the feasibility domain of the Section 5 virulence-transmission optimization. The paper's displayed Figure 3 parameter set satisfies the missing condition and is not changed by this result. No alternative evolutionary objective is analyzed.

title: The virulence optimum can lie outside the model's probability domain
